_comment: Real-RTL schedule: mlp_control + dronet on FireSim quad-rocket-saturn (4 RVV rocket cores). Profile data collected via the multi-model pool-sweep harness — 2 models x 3 pool sizes = 6 results.csv files per topo_<cores> dir. Each scheduled 'machine' here gets a single RVV core (topo_0 profile), since the FireSim measurements showed pthreadpool dispatch overhead dwarfs the work for these op sizes — a pair of single-core machines beats one shared 4-core pool.
